_doc: Credential routes, tried in order. Kinds: env, env_all, file, cli_scope, cli_ok. A route only proves a binding or a login exists; no secret value is read. The single card per credential opens only when every route failed. BG-12, BG-13.

card.what: Approve the Ultrastable GitHub App for the organization in one consent click: https://ultrastable.io/connect/github
card.why: minting the owner's credential is identity-bound
card.default: work stays in the canonical repository; org page holds

card.what: Sign in once to the Cloudflare account the system runs on, on Cloudflare's own page
card.why: minting the owner's credential is identity-bound
card.default: runtime and site stay in dry-run

card.what: Allow paid model use for the agents; until then they run on the free Workers AI model, which needs no key
card.why: a credential only the owner can mint
card.default: agents run simulated or on the free runtime model tier
card.probe: first live tick records a real model call

card.what: Register one sender mailbox for outreach
card.why: sending as the owner is identity-bound; the system never sends from the personal mailbox
card.default: outreach runs dry-run, everything queued and guarded
card.probe: dry-run flag off and a test message to a seed address arrives

card.what: Open the Bluesky and Mastodon accounts in your own name, which accepts their terms, then link each in one click from https://ultrastable.io/connect
card.why: account creation accepts terms in the owner's name and has no API
card.default: posting stays dry-run; channels that need no account (repo, registry pull requests, feeds) carry the work
